game_named: Snake (grid snake that eats food), or failing that a similar 4-direction grid collection game.
quote: W1 rows look about equally heavy whether their inputs are active or not, so this is largely a prior-based guess.
judge_notes: Borderline between the two naming classes. It uses W3 to rule out paddle games, which is arguing from weight patterns. But its reasons for picking Snake come from the observation wording and the no-op bias, and it ties the choice to W1 failing to support it ('W1 has no clear spatial pattern... largely a prior-based guess'). I treated it like 430e4c92: the reply says its pick is not supported by the weights, so names_with_recognition. It is a weaker case than 430e4c92, which says explicitly that the weights do not identify the game.
